products.title: SFJ009
products.body_html: Prospex Seiko Watchmaking 110th Anniversary Limited Edition. To mark 110 years of watchmaking excellence, Seiko is highlighting its continuous dedication to evolving technology, as well as diversity, equality and the sustainable manufacturing necessary to meet environmental challenges. Available only in a controlled-production run of 3,500, this exceptional Limited Edition celebrates both the 110th anniversary of Seiko watchmaking and the 40th anniversary of Seiko's – and the world’s – first analog quartz chronograph, which offered a 1/100-second stopwatch. Featuring the new solar chronograph 8A50 movement, powered by any light source, with no battery change required and a 6-month power reserve when fully charged, this remarkable timepiece provides chronograph measurement of up to 60 minutes of elapsed time in 1/100-second increments with a split time function. The concave tops of the hammer-shaped pushers allow easy utilization of the stopwatch feature. For enhanced legibility, the uniquely designed dial includes a white base with four inset black subdials, separating the time dial from the chronograph indicators, LumiBrite hands and markers, and, in tribute to the 1913 Laurel, Seiko’s first wristwatch, red hands on the top three subdials. With a curved anti-reflective sapphire crystal, this durable stainless steel timepiece includes a screwdown caseback and tri-fold push button release clasp, and comes with an additional dark brown sustainable leather strap certified by the Leather Working Group (LWG). Packaged in a Limited Edition collectors’ box. 10 bar, 100M Water Resistant

products.body_html: Seiko 5 Sports SKX GMT U.S. Special Creation. Adding new richness to classic sport/dress design, this stylish watch delivers all-day versatility with a cutting edge. With its GMT function and stylish five-row bracelet, this dynamic watch offers a new variation on the popular "SKX" style. Equipped with automatic technology that you control with every movement, this versatile timepiece is powered by a 24-jewel movement that beats at a frequency of 21,600 vibrations per hour, with a power reserve of approximately 41 hours and manual winding capability. The first SKX design to offer a two-tone case, this exceptional watch features a charcoal gray dial with bold luminous hands and markers, and a magnified date calendar, as well as a large gold-tone GMT hand for easy second time zone tracking. Crafted of stainless steel in two-tone finish, with a bi-color 24-hour GMT bezel, tri-fold push button release clasp and lock, and a screwdown see-through caseback for a view of classic timekeeping in action. 10 bar, 100M Water Resistant
